paragraphs: R' Hananiah, son of R' Yose the Galilean.

notes.text: The heading has חנניא, Hananiah, and the target חנינא, Hanina. These different supplied forms are retained with conventional vowels.
The heading explicitly identifies the father as Yose the Galilean. The second unit is the pointer to Hanina; no further biography is supplied. All three abbreviated titles remain R'.
